answer: The finality of attestations only counts when the attestator is established, so a fresh cluster of aliases cannot push any transaction to finality until it has spent many epochs proving honesty. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consider a anchor as the anchor of the cost. A terrace stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a ledge holds...
